note: tools/list of the plugin's relay (Claude Code, Cowork). The relay serves this list at once; the section and file enums are filled from the published index the service fetched online (call tool 'list', params {skill: '*', form: 'tools'}; C1 request A-4) when it answers, followed by notifications/tools/list_changed. For --for claude-desktop and --for codex the relay serves chatbuild's one 'theodore' tool instead.

tools.name: pptx
tools.description: Theodore's engine on this computer: runs one pptx command (the same arguments as `theodore pptx` in a shell) and returns its answer; pictures come back as images.

args.description: what follows `theodore pptx`, one argument per item, e.g. ["slide", "list", "/path/to/workspace"]

cwd.description: the folder relative paths start from; absolute paths need none

images.description: false to leave pictures out of the answer (their paths stay in the text)

tools.name: guide
tools.description: Returns one file of a Theodore skill, whole, or several files in one answer.

section.description: one section, or a list fetched in one request (C6)

role.description: "slide" for an agent given one slide.

tools.name: specimen
tools.description: Returns specimen sheets as images: one file, or a list of up to 6 (each image after its file name).

file.description: one sheet, or a list fetched in one request (C6)

tools.name: theodore
tools.description: Theodore's own commands on this computer: status, doctor, report, prefs, studio, packs, update, version (the same arguments as `theodore <command>` in a shell).

tools.name: list
tools.description: Lists the files of a Theodore skill.
